{"lens":"claude-fable-fallback","verdict":"fail","findings":[{"rule":2,"file":"tools/second_lens.sh","line":129,"reason":"The pre-flight `read_the_verdict where` runs with JUDGE_HOME=$REPO_ROOT, i.e. before the judge is materialised out of the pinned ref. When the build skill invokes the script from inside the worktree, REPO_ROOT is the tree under review, so the branch's own src/lens_verdict.py (and the src/interpreter_pin.py it imports) execute with the caller's privileges before any pin, diff-range check or DEFINES_THE_JUDGE check runs. That falsifies two sentences this change adds: HOW_WE_WORK §6 'the module that decides what a verdict is now come[s] out of a pinned ref rather than the worktree', and 'the hole itself is closed by a person reading the diff of that one file [tools/second_lens.sh]' — a reviewer reading only that diff never sees code planted in the tree's src/lens_verdict.py `where` path, which can rewrite the still-running script on disk, the .venv link $LENS_PYTHON resolves through, or the ledger. The interpreter question can be asked without importing the tree's module (e.g. `$LENS_PYTHON -c 'import sys, jsonschema'`), and no test exercises a tree whose lens_verdict.py misbehaves before the pin."},{"rule":2,"file":"docs/routines/weekly-relens.md","line":31,"reason":"The routine selects rows with `grep -v '\"judge_from\": \"main\"'`, but the routine's own invocation sets LENS_JUDGE_BASE=<merge commit>^1 and the script writes JUDGE_FROM=\"$JUDGE_BASE\" verbatim, so every row the routine itself appends carries judge_from '<sha>^1' and is re-selected the following week, forever; a `pass` moves the task row to done and the same ledger row still qualifies for re-read every week after. tests/test_second_lens.py line 1644 (`test_the_routine_s_own_pin_is_still_accepted`) sets LENS_JUDGE_BASE=main, not a `<sha>^1` form, so the routine's real invocation is never exercised and the loop is judged by nothing."},{"rule":2,"file":"docs/next_cycle_tasks.md","line":46,"reason":"The ledger keys a run by `item`, and the routine's pass row 'moves the row in docs/next_cycle_tasks.md' by that title. The task-list row and the earlier ledger line are titled 'one verdict schema, two lenses, and a price source that is decided'; this lens run was invoked as 'one verdict schema, two lenses, and prices with two backends', so the ledger row written for it will not match the task-list row it is meant to confirm. Nothing checks that the title handed to the script is a row in the file."}],"reads":8}
